enchantment.reforged.lifesteal.desc: Heals you for a portion of the damage you deal.
enchantment.reforged.auto_smelt.desc: Smelts mined blocks as they drop.
enchantment.reforged.vein_miner.desc: Mines connected ore blocks in one go.
enchantment.reforged.magnet.desc: Sends what you mine straight to your inventory.
enchantment.reforged.auto_replant.desc: Replants mature crops you harvest, using a seed from your inventory.
